mainEntity.name: Can intake forms be sent to patients before their first visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Intake forms are sent digitally to patients so they can fill it out on their own device prior to the visit. You can also automate surveys to go out at set intervals before visits, relieving your front office team from repetitive work.

mainEntity.name: Does Prompt have 2-way texting with patients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through Prompt Engage, our branded patient app, you can 2-way message to keep patients connected between visits, alongside our broader patient communication tools.

We do not have a traditional patient portal. Instead, patients get link-based tools for the tasks that matter most: booking visits, paying balances, viewing statements, completing intake, and doing their home exercise program (HEP), all without creating a login. You can share your clinic's unique link with any patient for payments and statements.
